examination_weight_method.full_marks_rule: Each linked demand receives the FULL tariff of its directly linked part as contextual examination weight, not criterion credit. Multi-demand part tariffs overlap: do not sum these per-demand marks or their percentages to infer a 750-mark distribution.
examination_weight_method.optional_share_rule: Equal-split share is a judgement-only reviewer crosscheck. It is not official mark allocation or prediction.
